correctness.rationale: Successive squaring of first column forces all later columns. If a_s,a_t ≠0 for 1≤s<t<n, coefficient of e_(t+1) in f(e1) f(e_(t-s+1)) is a_t a_s^(2^(t-s))≠0, contradicting mixed product relation; a sole nonterminal coordinate is sufficient because shifted supports are disjoint. In universal coordinate ring the mixed-product ideal I lies within squarefree K=(a_s a_t), and each (a_s a_t)^N lies in radical(I); hence radical(I)=K and exactly n-1 affine-plane components share a line. First-column positions give all ranks and single-map nilpotence. Independently checked full generator-image census over F2 for n=2,3,4 and F3 for n=3, with exact predicted counts and idempotents; finite checks do not prove all fields or reduced-scheme claim.
